items: 【Materiel】This long sleeve bodysuit is made of 75%Nylon25% & Spandex,soft,sleek,high-stretch fabric.It is super skin feell,creamy and stretchy,which can mould to your body and stretch to twice its size,suitable for all body types.TIPS:Bodysuit for women has a little shaping function, if you want a comfortable feel, please buy a size up

【Design】Sheer bodysuit for women feature Turtle neck and mesh sleeves ,design with double-layer fabric, layered ruched decoration,from chest to waist with super soft material,make it more slim fitting, bring a sense of detail design to basic styles, but also make them more elegant and versatile,great staple for your wardrobe.

【Style】Mesh bodysuit with a thong back that makes it seamless under clothing. with 2 snap closure on the crotch buttons, stable and makes it convenient for your lavatory visits. Perfect going out outfits for women.

【Occasion】This women's shapewear bodysuit well match with jeans,pants or skirts,blazer form a professional,sexy,feminine look.great for daily wear,streetwear,country concert,rave party, club,going out,dating,beach,travel,vacation,etc.
